first_attempt.note: Preserved pre-Arc attempt: Pine queue improved, native median step rate fell 6.9%; publisher counters exposed neighboring element copies.

validation.postgres: Separate task-local Rust/HTTP databases, 127.0.0.1:56681; fsync, synchronous_commit and full_page_writes on.
validation.retained_environment_failure: tests-pg-final.log: five builtins-only recovery tests encountered Pine rooms left by earlier HTTP tests in the shared test DB. Re-run passed in a separate fresh Rust DB; no recovery validation was relaxed.

limitations: Memory journal short load windows; PostgreSQL checks establish correctness, not saturation/capacity.
Only ma.pine/rsi.pine/breakout.pine measured, with existing qualified opt-in Rust backend. Default process-worker throughput and arbitrary scripts not qualified.
Per-run medians of two ABBA repetitions. Async order flows differ; not fixed transaction counts or long-duration stability.
FIFO excludes later compute/write waiting. Matched successful commit-return latency is a proxy, not proof of per-decision admission or bar-close-to-durable-order latency.
Ladder cases have one run each. Final endpoint backlog is retained; a one-bar cutoff lag alone does not prove growing backlog. No failed gate is relabeled as passing.
History bounds, script allowlist, gateway/risk rules, durable journal schema and default Rust enablement remain unchanged.
